description:
A query_string full-text clause — parses the query against the strict Lucene query-string syntax (boolean operators, grouping, ranges, fuzziness, boosting, wildcards, and field prefixes).

Known limitation: field references embedded in the query text (e.g. title: wind) are not rewritten from column name to column id, because the rewrite operates on the JSON structure and cannot reach into the Lucene expression. Such an embedded reference only resolves if the caller spells the column id. Restrict searched columns with the structural fields / default_field properties instead, which are rewritten normally.

fields.description: Optional. The columns to search. Each entry may carry a ^boost suffix. Defaults to the index's default search fields.

default_field.description: Optional. The column searched for terms that do not name a field. Defaults to the index's default search field.

default_operator.description: Optional. Boolean logic used between terms when no explicit operator is given: or (default) or and.

analyzer.description: Optional. Analyzer used to tokenize the query text. Defaults to each field's search analyzer.

quote_analyzer.description: Optional. Analyzer used to tokenize quoted (exact-phrase) portions of the query text.

allow_leading_wildcard.description: Optional. Whether * or ? may begin a search term. Default true. A leading wildcard forces a full index scan.

analyze_wildcard.description: Optional. Whether to analyze wildcard terms. Default false. A leading wildcard with this enabled is rejected (it forces a full index scan).

auto_generate_synonyms_phrase_query.description: Optional. Whether to auto-generate phrase queries for multi-term synonyms. Default true.

enable_position_increments.description: Optional. Whether resulting queries are aware of position increments. Default true.

fuzziness.description: Optional. Maximum edit distance for fuzzy term matching. A non-negative integer or AUTO. Default AUTO.

fuzzy_max_expansions.description: Optional. Maximum number of terms a fuzzy expansion will generate. Default 50.

fuzzy_prefix_length.description: Optional. Number of leading characters left unchanged when fuzzy matching.

fuzzy_transpositions.description: Optional. Whether to count transpositions (ab → ba) as a single edit. Default true.

lenient.description: Optional. When true, type mismatches between the query and the field are ignored.

max_determinized_states.description: Optional. Maximum number of automaton states a regular-expression term may create. Default 10000.

phrase_slop.description: Optional. Maximum number of positions allowed between matched terms in a phrase. Default 0 (exact phrase).

quote_field_suffix.description: Optional. Suffix appended to field names for quoted (exact-phrase) portions of the query.

rewrite.description: Optional. How OpenSearch rewrites and scores multi-term queries (e.g. constant_score).

time_zone.description: Optional. UTC offset (e.g. -08:00) applied to date-range terms in the query text.

type.description: Optional. How per-field matches are combined: best_fields (default), most_fields, cross_fields, phrase, phrase_prefix, or bool_prefix.
